items: At 10:33 ET, at the end of a work session, the company's file guard put back a file that only the Investors edit (Commandment 2): .claude/settings.json. Who made the change: the tool cannot tell. Nobody committed this change: it was left in the files on the Mac mini with no name or reason. If you approve, .claude/settings.json gets the change shown below (10 lines added, 0 removed), written to GitHub from your own account. If you disapprove, .claude/settings.json stays as it is now, without this change. No recommendation: the tool cannot tell who made the change.
